mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM observability_alert_event ev WHERE

SELECT CAST(ev.id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST(ev.rule_id AS VARCHAR) AS "ruleId", ev.rule_name AS "ruleName", ev.metric AS "metric", ev.level AS "level", ev.tenant_code AS "tenantCode", ev.metric_value AS "metricValue", ev.threshold AS "threshold", ev.window_days AS "windowDays", to_char(ev.stat_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "statDate", ev.detail AS "detail", ev.handle_status AS "handleStatus", ev.handle_remark AS "handleRemark", ev.handler_name AS "handlerName", to_char(ev.handle_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "handleTime", ev.notified AS "notified", to_char(ev.event_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "eventTime" FROM observability_alert_event ev WHERE ORDER BY (ev.handle_status = 1) DESC, ev.level DESC, ev.event_time DESC, ev.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE handle_status = 1) AS pending, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE level = 3) AS critical, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE level = 2) AS warning, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= CURRENT_DATE) AS today FROM observability_alert_event
mapper.update: UPDATE observability_alert_event SET handle_status = #{status}, handle_remark = #{remark}, handler_name = #{handler}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO observability_alert_event (id, rule_id, rule_name, metric, level, tenant_code, metric_value, threshold, window_days, stat_date, detail, handle_status, notified, event_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{event.id}, #{event.ruleId}, #{event.ruleName}, #{event.metric}, #{event.level}, #{event.tenantCode}, #{event.metricValue}, #{event.threshold}, #{event.windowDays}, #{event.statDate}, #{event.detail}, #{event.handleStatus}, #{event.notified}, #{event.eventTime}, #{event.createTime}, #{event.updateTime}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
